details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path at lines 241-245 and emit_context at lines 568-580; the deleted is_sensitive_target_path guard (previously at lines 157-168) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection was removed, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths to inline `.git`, credential, environment, and other sensitive files into model prompts.
  WHY: Untrusted paths can reach `read_bytes()` and expose secrets through prompts and workflow logs.

- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _git_subprocess_env at lines 2987-2992, _inject_token_into_url at lines 3038-3052, _resolve_origin_url at lines 3074-3087 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded in HTTPS URLs passed to git subprocesses after per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication was removed.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, temporary `.git/config`, remote output, and diagnostics.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url at lines 581-586 and memory_ensure_branch at lines 151, 180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remotes expose tokens in URLs, while `memory_ensure_branch` uses unauthenticated `git ls-remote` and `git push` after `_memory_git` authentication was removed.
  WHY: Tokens leak through git execution and diagnostics, and first-use ai-memory initialization fails silently with `persist-credentials: false`.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose runs issue-derived prompts with `codex exec --sandbox danger-full-access` without the model-provider broker.
  WHY: Prompt injection can access credentials and mutate the workspace or remotes while `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` remain available.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: entire model_provider_broker_* family deleted; file ends after codex_config_assemble at approximately line 140 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Shared broker lifecycle and credential-isolation functions were deleted while live workflow and script callers remain.
  WHY: Those phases fail with `command not found` before Codex starts; the broker isolation boundary is also absent.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage line 7 and option parser at lines 30-66; scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and its process-group supervision were removed while the editor caller still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with an unknown-option error and process-group cleanup metadata is not written.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 493-947 and deleted review_blocked_* plus git_with_github_auth helpers | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked approval/successor helpers and `git_with_github_auth` were removed while live callers remain.
  WHY: Guarded terminal actions silently remain pending, and unguarded judge-fix pushes fail with `command not found`.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: option parser at lines 29-35, 85-90, 95-100, 105-110, 143-148 and hardcoded base_url at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed and the base URL is hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` while a live caller still passes the option.
  WHY: The security-pass config step exits on an unknown argument, and successful callers bypass the loopback broker.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30, 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed from `scripts/targeted_file_context.py`.
  WHY: Pytest raises `ImportError` during collection before any tests execute.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: REST transform at line 769 and GraphQL transform at lines 913-924 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comment payloads dropped `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval verification cannot bind producer comments or qualify approvers even if the deleted helpers are restored.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 101-237, especially the restore gate at lines 123-125 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, which no workflow creates or exports.
  WHY: The restore mechanism is dead, allowing self-repository implement runs to replace branch-owned helper edits with support-reference copies.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 203-204 (`git merge-file` invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reviewers report that the three-way merge passes the support baseline and HEAD in the wrong roles.
  WHY: They conclude branch-specific changes may be silently dropped; moonshotai_kimi-k3 explicitly verified this claim as false and states the argument order is correct.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 203-204 and 219, 222 (`${SCRIPT_REF}`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reviewers report that `${SCRIPT_REF}` is unset in the restore block under `set -u`.
  WHY: They conclude the block can abort when reached; moonshotai_kimi-k3 verified `${SCRIPT_REF:-support ref}` defaults are present and disputes this finding.

- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: lines 1-76, especially lines 44, 55, 59, 62, 77 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support rejection handler references `${SSB_FILES}` without defining it.
  WHY: If the handler path is reached under `set -u`, it can fail before posting the guard comment or alert; moonshotai_kimi-k3 notes the branch is dead because its activation inputs are never set.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 100 (`patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose config patch ignores `CODEX_HOME` and writes `${HOME:-/root}/.codex/config.toml`.
  WHY: When `CODEX_HOME` is customized, the patched file may not be the configuration consumed by Codex.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 440-448 and 577-585 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Scope-guard lookup depends on `IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR`, which no workflow exports.
  WHY: The fallback only works from the repository root and can fail to enforce scope in relocated workspace layouts.

- scripts/label_helpers.sh: lines 10-19 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `gh_helpers.sh` is sourced through `${LABEL_HELPERS_SCRIPT_DIR}/gh_helpers.sh` and may not exist at that resolved path in consumer layouts.
  WHY: Label operations can fail when support files are sourced from a different working-directory layout; moonshotai_kimi-k3 verified this change as an improvement rather than a regression.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-81 versus memory_ensure_branch at line 480 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication exports are scoped to the earlier workflow step and are not persisted for later memory operations.
  WHY: Later `memory_ensure_branch` calls inherit no authentication and fail against credential-free HTTPS origins.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context at lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The 256-path cap and complete byte accounting for headers, wrappers, and markers were removed.
  WHY: Large untrusted path lists can exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES` and inflate model context usage.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Resolve all critical mutable-code security findings across affected workflows and sibling paths."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: Deleted model-provider broker, review-blocked approval/authentication helpers, process-group supervision, broker URL support, sensitive-path and byte-cap guards, and per-command git authentication; replacements include URL-embedded tokens, bare git calls, and `--sandbox danger-full-access`.

- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line: the re-audit checks sibling code paths (other venues, adapters, handlers, workers) for the same defect and re-opens the loop if any remain."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Existing callers and tests still exercise the deleted broker, process-group, review-blocked, targeted-context, config, and memory-auth interfaces; the defects are present across sibling paths rather than only cited lines.

- requirement: "Load issue-status helpers only from validated job.workflow_sha, rejecting mutable fallbacks and failing closed when the immutable checkout is unavailable."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Telegram cleanup and downstream lineage paths have partial helper verification; later memory operations lack authentication, and no contract test covers every configured executable path.

- requirement: "Preserve existing triggers, interfaces, memory behavior, and Telegram no-op behavior when unconfigured."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: Live callers remain
